introH2: 🏭 What types of stays are there near the 304 Industrial Park in Si Maha Phot, and how do you pick the right one for the trip?
introHtml: The 304 Industrial Park in Si Maha Phot district is one of the largest industrial estates in eastern Thailand, packed with factories and foreign companies, which keeps good stays in this area in high demand — and once people start looking, many find the accommodation here doesn't come in just one shape · Some are resorts set in wide lakeside gardens that sell quiet and space, some are hotel-group serviced apartments with roomy units and a small kitchen, ideal for a stay of several weeks, some are resorts built around a full Japanese concept, and some are budget residences that simply look better than the typical dorm near a factory · Plenty of people book first and only then realize the facilities or location don't match what they actually came for, even though the prices weren't all that different · This article rounds up 6 stays in the 304 Industrial Park area of Si Maha Phot that we've reviewed in depth, from a 4-star resort all the way to residences in the low hundreds — every one drawn from reading guests' real reviews, telling you the good and the caveats honestly, with a 3-site price compare and direct booking links throughout.
mrtHtml: Prachinburi has no train line, and the 304 Industrial Park area in Si Maha Phot is a place where nearly everything needs a car — reviews from all 6 stays agree that public transport in this zone is thin and taxis are hard to flag. If you're not driving yourself, ask about the property's shuttle service or have a transport plan ready · From Bangkok it's about a 1.5 hour drive with no traffic (roughly 140 km from Suvarnabhumi), mostly via the motorway and then Highway 304 (Kabin Buri-Chachoengsao) or 319 into Si Maha Phot · Around the area, most stays are about a 5–15 min drive from the 304 estate and near a Big C, Lotus's, and a Major Cineplex in the same zone, which keeps food and supplies easy · Going further, Prachinburi town and Chao Phya Abhaibhubejhr Hospital are about 20–40 min, Kabin Buri about 20–40 min, and the Prachinburi side of Khao Yai about 20 min to an hour depending on where you're headed.

entries.name: Tawa Ravadee Resort Prachinburi
entries.revCount: Trip.com · WorldHotels Distinctive · 199 rooms on 120 rai
entries.badge: 🌿 Largest garden resort in the area
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Tha Tum·Si Maha Phot · Near Abhaibhubejhr ~20 min
entries.addr: 77 Moo 7, Tha Tum, Si Maha Phot, Prachinburi
entries.storyHtml: If we start with the stay locals think of first, plenty of reviews give it to this one — Tawa Ravadee Resort is a full garden resort on more than 120 rai in Si Maha Phot district, in the 304 estate area, with Thai-contemporary room buildings arranged in a U around a central court that takes in a lake, a lotus pond, lawns, and rice paddies the resort grows itself · It has been open since 1995, went through a major renovation in 2024, and is a WorldHotels Distinctive member under the Best Western Signature Collection · What clearly sets it apart from other stays in the area is that it's a genuine garden resort, not a tower hotel with a few ornamental plants — many reviews agree on the shade, the greenery, and grounds wide enough for kids to run around freely · All 199 rooms start at 38 sqm and every one has a private balcony opening onto a garden or lake view, the detail reviews mention most often, because many say sitting on the balcony with a coffee in the early morning listening to the birds is the best part of the stay · Another highlight is the large outdoor pool that looks out over the lake, plus a fitness room, sauna, tennis court, massage room, and up to 10 meeting rooms that seat several hundred, which is why seminar and corporate groups choose it regularly · The breakfast buffet at the Tiwaratri restaurant is another point reviews praise for variety, and many say it's one reason they'd come back · The honest caveats from the reviews: this location all but requires a car, since there's nothing within walking distance of the resort; Wi-Fi is slow in some rooms and a few TVs are older models; check-in can be slow when a big seminar group arrives; and a small number of reviews mention a smell from the industrial zone on some nights when the wind blows that way · Best for families and couples driving in for a garden-resort getaway, seminar groups, and anyone coming on business near Abhaibhubejhr Hospital who wants room to breathe.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Ask for a lakeside room, since the balcony opens onto the water and garden — the angle reviews praise most · Request a 2024-renovated room when you book, and if you're worried about the smell, ask reception about the wind direction before you check in.
pros: Garden resort on 120 rai with a lake and lotus pond, quiet and far roomier than other stays in the area
38 sqm rooms, every one with a garden or lake-view balcony (the detail reviews praise most)
Large pool with lake view, fitness, tennis, and 10 meeting rooms for groups
Breakfast buffet that draws praise, warm and friendly staff (from the reviews)
cons: Out-of-town location, needs a car, nothing within walking distance
Slow Wi-Fi in some rooms, a few older TVs · slow check-in when groups arrive
A small number of reviews mention a smell from the industrial zone on some nights (from the reviews)

entries.name: Kantary 304 Hotel & Serviced Apartment
entries.revCount: Trip.com 9.1 · 108 reviews · TripAdvisor ~4.6/5 · 297 rooms in 6 buildings
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Tha Tum·Si Maha Phot · Near 304 estate ~15 min
tags: 🍳 Roomy units with a small kitchen
entries.addr: 689 Moo 10, Tha Tum, Si Maha Phot, Prachinburi
entries.storyHtml: Among the 6 stays in the 304 estate area, measured by review score Kantary 304 Hotel & Serviced Apartment is the top scorer in this article at 9.1 from 108 reviews on Trip.com and around 4.6/5 on TripAdvisor · It's a 4-star hotel and serviced apartment in the Cape & Kantary Hotels group, designed for "people who have to be in Prachinburi for several days" more than for a single overnight, set on the Tha Tum side, about a 15 min drive from the 304 Industrial Park · The group it suits best, and the one most mentioned in reviews, is businesspeople, engineers, and staff coming in to work or train in the estate, plus foreign guests — especially Japanese — staying for weeks or months at a time, because the units are serviced apartments with a small kitchen for cooking your own meals · There are up to 297 rooms across 6 buildings, from a Deluxe around 38 sqm up to Studio Suite, One Bedroom, and Two Bedroom Suites of 45–68 sqm, most coming with a small kitchen, fridge, microwave, and bathtub · What the real reviews agree on most is that the rooms are wide and very clean, with many saying everything in the room works well and is well looked after · The facilities are another edge over other stays in the province, with an outdoor pool, a jacuzzi, a fully equipped fitness room, a sauna, a steam room, and a golf simulator that guests can use free · The breakfast buffet at The Orchard restaurant and Café Kantary 304 is another strength that keeps a long stay in the estate zone from getting dull · The honest caveats from the reviews: the most-mentioned point is getting around — the hotel is in the estate zone where you can't walk anywhere yourself and taxis are hard to flag, so it's tough without your own car; the building has been open for years and the decor is the group's classic style rather than a fresh design; and some reviews wish there were more halal options at breakfast · Best for people who have to stay several days to work in the 304 estate, families who want a roomy unit with a kitchen, and anyone using it as a base for the Prachinburi side of Khao Yai.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: For a long stay or a group, pick a suite-style room with a small kitchen — better value than a single room · Sort out a car ahead of time, since taxis are hard to flag in the estate zone · And if you're staying several weeks, ask about the monthly (long-stay) rate, which usually beats booking by the night.
pros: Top score in this article at 9.1 · rooms are wide and very clean, many with a small kitchen for long stays
Most facilities in the area — pool, jacuzzi, fitness, sauna, golf simulator
Steady, predictable Cape & Kantary group service · breakfast buffet that draws praise
About 15 min from the 304 estate, near Big C and Major · large free parking
cons: Estate-zone location, can't walk anywhere yourself, taxis hard to flag, needs a car
Building has been open for years, classic group decor rather than a fresh design
Highest starting price in the group · some reviews wish for more halal options at breakfast (from the reviews)

entries.name: The Garden 304
entries.revCount: Trip.com 8.7 · ~120 rooms · designed by a Japanese designer, opened 2016
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Tha Tum·Si Maha Phot · A few min drive from 304
tags: 🛁 Soaking tub with garden view, latex beds
entries.addr: 686, 688 Moo 10, Tha Tum, Si Maha Phot, Prachinburi
entries.storyHtml: The Garden 304 is a Japanese-style resort that lands in a spot the estate area rarely offers — "close to the 304 estate but with a real getaway feel" · It isn't a plain business hotel meant just for crashing overnight, but a 4-star resort built around a Modern Japanese concept throughout, with Japanese designer Mr. Masashi Ohata overseeing the architecture and interiors, open since 2016 · What the real reviews agree on is that the rooms are wide, quiet, and the Japanese feel is done seriously — the Studio Deluxe starts at around 45 sqm, almost double the entry room of a typical resort, with Slumberland latex mattresses and bathrooms fitted with Japanese auto-toilets and a soaking tub that in some rooms looks out onto the garden or pool while you bathe · The most-mentioned highlight is the saltwater pools, of which there are two, floored with dark Sukabumi stone imported from Indonesia, which turns the water emerald-green in sunlight and suits people who dislike the smell of chlorine, plus a fitness room, sauna, golf simulator, and a coffee lounge stocked with Japanese manga and magazines to read · The food is done well too, with an Italian-style wood-fired pizza oven and fresh vegetables from the resort's own farm in Pak Chong, and an international breakfast buffet with Japanese options · Many reviews land on the same line — "it feels like a trip to Japan without the long flight" · The honest caveats from the reviews: the most-mentioned point is inconsistent service — some staff greet you little and the shuttle is sometimes late and needs a phone call to chase; next is the out-of-town location with few eateries within walking distance of the resort, so a car helps; and prices run higher than ordinary hotels in the province · Best for 304-estate workers who want a stay better than the usual hotel, couples and families after a Japanese feel near Bangkok, and anyone stopping over on the Prachin-Kabin Buri-Khao Yai route.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: If a garden-view soaking tub or a room that opens onto the pool matters to you, request it when you book, since not every room has the same view · Check whether the package includes breakfast (you can add it for roughly 250 baht adult / 150 baht child) · And if you'll use the shuttle, confirm the time with the resort clearly in advance.
pros: Modern Japanese design throughout by a Japanese designer, a Japan-trip feel near Bangkok
Wide 45 sqm studios, latex beds, soaking tubs and Japanese-style bathrooms
2 saltwater pools floored with Sukabumi stone, easy on the eyes · fitness, golf simulator
Breakfast buffet with Japanese options, wood-fired pizza, vegetables from the Pak Chong farm (from the reviews)
cons: Inconsistent service, some staff greet you little, the shuttle is sometimes late (from the reviews)
Out-of-town location, a car helps, few eateries within walking distance of the resort
Prices higher than ordinary hotels in the province · no pets allowed

entries.name: The Canal 304 Hotel & Residence
entries.revCount: Trip.com ~9.4 · 240 reviews · most reviews in the group · ~62 suites

entries.addr: 888 Moo 10, Tha Tum, Si Maha Phot, Prachinburi
entries.storyHtml: Among the 6 stays in the 304 estate area, measured by sheer volume of reviews The Canal 304 Hotel & Residence has the most in this article — around 240 reviews on Trip.com with a score as high as about 9.4 · What makes it stick in memory is that it's a 4-star hotel and residence and the only canalside hotel in this neighborhood, set in Tha Tum, Si Maha Phot, in the 304 Industrial Park area · The group it suits best and that mentions it most is estate workers, engineers, and factory managers who have to be on-site for days or weeks, suppliers flying in to inspect work, and families visiting people working in the estate · Because the units here are suites with a small kitchen and a big fridge built in, you can settle in for a long stay like you have a small home, without eating out every meal · The rooms split into two groups, the 39 sqm Standard Suite and the 59 sqm Luxury Suite, in a bright, light-wood-against-white palette that leans airy and easy on the eyes · What the real reviews agree on is that the rooms are wide, very clean (cleanliness gets the top score in many reviews), the beds are comfortable, and it's quiet enough for sleep, with some rooms having a washing machine on the balcony that long-stay guests love · The facilities include a saltwater pool that's easy on the eyes, a fitness room, a men's and women's sauna, a meeting room, and free bikes to borrow · The location helps a lot too, near Big C and Major Cineplex at only about 0.65 km · Some foreign reviews even call it the best-value stay they've come across · The honest caveats from the reviews: the most-mentioned point is the fairly quiet location with little to see around, so it suits people coming to work more than to sightsee; next is service in the restaurant being slow at times, with orders taking nearly an hour when it's busy; and one reviewer noted the TV signal and a restaurant glass partition that looked unclean · Best for people with real business in the 304 estate area who want a wide, clean suite with a small kitchen at a good-value price.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: For a long stay, specify when booking that you want a room with a full small kitchen and a big fridge (some rooms have a washing machine on the balcony) · Breakfast is usually charged separately (around 200 baht), so pick a package that includes it when you book if you want it · On days you'd rather not wait for the restaurant, walk to the Big C about 650 meters away and bring food to cook in the room.
pros: Most reviews in the group, around 240 · cleanliness gets the top score in many reviews
Only canalside hotel in the area, an airy feel you won't get from an apartment near a factory
39–59 sqm suites with a small kitchen and big fridge, some with a washing machine, good for long stays
Saltwater pool, fitness, sauna, free bikes · near Big C and Major at about 0.65 km
cons: Estate-area location is fairly quiet with little to see around, suits work more than sightseeing
Restaurant service slow at times, orders can take nearly an hour when busy (from the reviews)
Breakfast usually charged separately from the room · nearly everything needs a car

entries.storyHtml: Where the other stays in this article lean on full facilities or a wide garden resort, The Green Residence 304 picks a different angle — "a good-looking stay at a budget price, close to work" · It's a 3-star apartment and residence for people with real business in the 304 Industrial Park area, in Tha Tum, Si Maha Phot · What sets it apart from the typical estate-area stay is the design — a 5-storey contemporary Thai building that leans on timber, both the interior woodwork and the warm brown tones of the grain, with trees around it as the name "Green" suggests, giving it a natural feel rather than the rigid look of a typical rental block · It has about 30 rooms, split into the 36 sqm Green Deluxe and the 30 sqm Green Superior, and a touch many people like is that every room has a private balcony for catching the breeze or sitting out in the evening, with air-conditioning, a TV, a fridge, a water heater, and hotel-grade spring mattresses that reviews say sleep better than the usual dorm bed · Its clearest edge is being only about a 5 min drive from the 304 estate and around 15 min from the Rojana estate, near Big C and Major at about 2.3 km, with security features like keycards, CCTV, an elevator, and free parking · The price is a strength too, with daily stays from around 600 baht and monthly stays in the range of around 3,500–7,500 baht a month, good for people who have to stay a while · The honest caveats, said plainly for the sake of transparency: there's no pool, no in-house fitness, and no breakfast included, the facilities lean toward real living rather than entertainment, the surroundings are a quiet estate area where nearly everything needs a car, and because it just opened for online booking there aren't many real reviews yet · Best for people coming to work or be stationed in the 304 estate who want a good-looking, clean, secure room at a budget price, bookable by the day or the month.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: If you'll be stationed in the estate for more than two weeks, ask about the monthly rate (around 3,500–7,500 baht), which is far better value than booking by the night, and ask clearly about water and electricity charges · The stay has no breakfast and no pool, so lean on the Big C and shops around it · And because it's a small, still-new property on the booking systems, contact them directly to confirm room availability and amenities, especially if you arrive late.
pros: Contemporary Thai timber design, warmer and more photogenic than the typical dorm near a factory
Every room has a private balcony, hotel-grade spring mattresses, clean and quiet rooms
Lowest starting price in the group, bookable by the day or the month · about 5 min from the 304 estate
Good security, keycards, CCTV, elevator, and free parking (from the reviews)
cons: No pool and no in-house fitness · no breakfast included in the room rate
Quiet estate area with little to see around, nearly everything needs a car
Just opened for online booking, few reviews yet, best to ask the property for details directly

entries.name: The Icon Service Apartment
entries.revCount: Trip.com 8.9 · 22 reviews · ~80 rooms · on Highway 304, Lotus's 200 m away
entries.badge: 🏭 On the highway · Lotus's 200 m away
entries.addr: 177/1 Highway 304 Kabin Buri-Chachoengsao, Tha Tum, Si Maha Phot, Prachinburi
entries.storyHtml: Closing out the article is the stay that nails "convenient if you have a car" most completely — The Icon Service Apartment · This isn't a foothill resort for a view, nor a town hotel where you can wander a night market, but a serious working serviced apartment built for the 304 Industrial Park area on the Tha Tum side of Si Maha Phot · The group it suits best, from the real reviews, is staff and engineers coming in to work or train in the estate, contractors and suppliers who have to stay a while, drivers passing along Route 304 who want a clean bed on the main road for a night, and families visiting people working in this zone · The number-one reason people pick it is the location — set on Highway 304, the main route linking Kabin Buri, Prachinburi, and Chachoengsao, with the Lotus's Si Maha Phot only about 200 meters away, Big C and Major about 1 km, and the 304 estate only about 2.7 km, with two ways in and out to help dodge the after-work jam · There are about 80 rooms in a multi-storey building with an elevator, from Superior up to Junior Suite, and what sets them apart from a typical hotel room is that every room has a private balcony, a fridge, and a microwave, which is a big deal for estate workers on shifts or coming back late, since you can buy food from Lotus's and heat it in the room easily · There's an in-house restaurant serving a breakfast buffet that reviews praise as tasty, plus a fitness room, a garden, free parking, laundry and dryer service, and it's open both by the day and the month · Prices start around 650 baht a night, which counts as good value once you add in the balcony, small kitchen, breakfast, fitness, and free parking · The honest caveats from the reviews: the most-mentioned point is that the room lighting is fairly dim, so anyone who likes a bright room should ask for more light; next is that parking is free but limited when the place is full; and there's no pool, with plain, practical decor · Best for people who have to stay or work in the 304 estate zone on the Si Maha Phot side and want a clean, easy-to-reach room with real living functions on a controlled budget.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: For a stay of a month, call 037-466111 or message LINE Theicon304 to ask about the monthly rate directly, since it's better value and often isn't shown on the booking sites · If you like a bright room, ask for one with brighter lighting or for extra bulbs at check-in · And pick a room with breakfast included when you book, since the difference is a few dozen baht but far more convenient in the morning.
pros: On Highway 304 with easy in and out, near Lotus's at about 200 m, 304 estate about 2.7 km away
Every room has a balcony, fridge, and microwave, heat your own meals, good for long stays
Breakfast that reviews praise as tasty, fitness, free parking · open both by the day and the month
Budget starting price, good and friendly staff (from the reviews)
cons: Lighting in some rooms is fairly dim, ask for more light if you like a bright room
Parking is free but limited when the place is full · no pool
Estate-community location, needs a car, not a tourist or nature area

faqTitle: FAQ — Common questions travelers ask about stays near the 304 estate in Si Maha Phot, Prachinburi

faq.q: ❓ What's the best stay near the 304 estate in Si Maha Phot?
faq.a: It depends on the trip and budget · By review score and the completeness of facilities, Kantary 304 Hotel has the top score at 9.1, with roomy units with kitchens, a pool, jacuzzi, and fitness · By volume of reviews and value, The Canal 304 has the most reviews at around 240, is canalside, and has suites with a small kitchen · For a wide garden resort, Tawa Ravadee Resort · For a Japanese feel, The Garden 304 · And for budget or a monthly stay, The Green Residence 304 or The Icon Service Apartment

faq.q: ❓ How much do stays near the 304 estate cost?
faq.a: In this article prices start at around ฿600–2,400 per night · On the budget side are The Green Residence 304 from ฿600 and The Icon Service Apartment from ฿650 · In the mid range are The Canal 304 from ฿1,400 and The Garden 304 from ฿1,700 · And at the top are Tawa Ravadee Resort from ฿1,900 and Kantary 304 from ฿2,400 · The Green Residence 304 and The Icon also offer monthly stays for estate workers · All prices are approximate starting rates from the standard room, and during estate events the price may run higher than usual

faq.q: ❓ Which stays near the 304 estate have a pool and full facilities?
faq.a: The ones with a pool are Tawa Ravadee Resort (large pool with lake view), Kantary 304 (pool + jacuzzi + fitness + sauna + golf simulator), The Garden 304 (2 saltwater pools), and The Canal 304 (saltwater pool + fitness + sauna) · As for The Green Residence 304, it has no pool or fitness, and The Icon Service Apartment has a fitness room but no pool · If a pool is essential, pick one of the first four

faq.q: ❓ Which stay near the 304 estate suits a long stay of weeks or months?
faq.a: The best fits for a long stay are the ones with a small kitchen or a monthly rate · Kantary 304 and The Canal 304 have suites with a small kitchen good for long stays (Kantary has a long-stay rate) · The Green Residence 304 and The Icon Service Apartment offer monthly stays directly at a budget price, with every room having a fridge (The Icon also has a microwave) · All four are popular with staff and engineers coming to work in the 304 estate for weeks or months

faq.q: ❓ Do you need your own car to go to the 304 estate in Si Maha Phot?
faq.a: You should have one · Reviews from all 6 stays agree that the 304 estate area is a place where nearly everything needs a car, public transport is thin, and taxis are hard to flag · Without your own car you should ask about the property's shuttle service or have a transport plan / motorbike rental ready · Many stays are a short drive from Big C, Lotus's, and Major, and have free parking, so it's most convenient if you drive yourself

faq.q: ❓ Coming to work at the 304 estate but want a getaway feel too — where should I pick?
faq.a: If you want both a location near the estate and a getaway feel · The Garden 304 gives a Japanese-resort feel with saltwater pools and garden-view soaking tubs · Tawa Ravadee Resort gives a wide lakeside garden-resort feel (a bit farther from the estate) · As for Kantary 304 and The Canal 304, they lean more on wide, clean rooms with kitchens and full facilities than on a natural setting · If you're after full-on nature or foothills, look instead at resorts on the Noen Hom side or the Prachinburi side of Khao Yai
